name: Warm Tres Leches Cake & Flan de Queso (Plaza de Coco)
whyItWorks: Milk-soaked sponge cake (Tres Leches), silky cream cheese flan, and Miguel's Cookies & Cream Sundae require zero mechanical digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Warm Tres Leches, Tía Gloria's Flan de Queso (skip the dried apricot/pineapple snap), or Miguel's Remember Me Sundae with a Lactaid pill. Avoid the Margarita Lime Cheesecake (citrus) and Mexican Chocolate Tart (spiced + pecan nuts).
watchOuts: Mexican Chocolate Tart (chili spice + whole pecans)
High dairy lactose — take a Lactaid enzyme
